text: RGTI is down 54% from its high with no profits, no free cash flow, and a REDUCE signal — the huge run-up has fully reversed and this position is broken, so selling now protects what's left.
RDW is down 22% with negative earnings, negative cash flow, 18% short interest, and four straight earnings misses — this thesis has failed and it's time to exit and stop the bleeding.

QBTS is 34% below its high, unprofitable, and has 15.5% short interest with a REDUCE signal — trim this to a small speculative position at most, because the quantum computing story alone isn't enough to justify holding a full position.
SKYT is up 70% and sitting right at its 52-week high, so consider trimming some gains here to lock in profits — when a stock runs this hard, taking some off the table is smart risk management.
LASR is up 74% but trades at a PE of 113 with bearish MACD turning against it — trim some profits now while you're well ahead, since that valuation leaves very little room for any stumble.
IONQ has 20% short interest, burns cash, and is unprofitable despite impressive revenue growth — with that many traders betting against it, trim to reduce your exposure to a potential sharp selloff.
Microsoft is down 9% with an ADD signal, strong free cash flow, consistent earnings beats, and 15% revenue growth — this pullback in a world-class company is a chance to add shares at a discount.

ONDS shows 605% revenue growth with very strong momentum and bullish MACD near its high — if you already own this, the signals support adding on strength, but keep the position size modest given how fast it's moved.
